scope: v0.8.0 installed candidate compatibility, Issues #210 and #217; no publication or stable-baseline claim

source.note: Production Python source is unchanged from this base; version metadata is 0.8.0. The installed wheel identity and module-content digest identify the tested candidate.

setup: The candidate-source directory is a fresh copy of pyproject.toml, README.md, LICENSE, and src/gwflow/*.py. The baseline wheel is built from git archive of its pinned commit. A venv with system-site-packages shares the copied candidate runtime dependencies but contains its own independently installed baseline gwflow.
selection: Preserve every CLI command and exit code and all handoff/outcome observations. Before path normalization, summarize per-file snapshots, accepted submissions, and exact-name history maps by counts/digests; preserve history state counts. Raw output and timestamps remain uncommitted.
limits: Exactly this bootstrap/candidate pair; not a promise for other pre-1.0 records or future 1.x releases.
Real local jobs confirmed terminal before stopping baseline workers and starting candidate workers; no storage relocation or manual conversion.

Existing fixtures replay observed terminal states by exact Submission name because local scheduler history is lost on restart. Recovery and negative cases deliberately expire history or simulate active consumers.
No production Slurm jobs; no live upgrades, mixed-version workers, downgrade, or representative production-pipeline validation.

path_placeholders.<REPO>: Absolute checkout root; relative paths start here; file://<REPO>/... preserves pip artifact URL shape.
path_placeholders.<BASELINE>: Independent baseline installation under local temporary storage.
path_placeholders.<CANDIDATE>: Copied Python 3.12 runtime with the independently installed candidate and example wheels on local temporary storage.
path_placeholders.<SECOND_FS_N>: Numbered temporary storage roots under /dev/shm. Each exact root and device/inode identity is preserved across the installation switch, then cleaned by the fixture.
